The ground truth corrects this by replacing the incorrect value in the prompt with the correct one (G = 80.8 GPa). The agent resolves this by creating a specification that calculates the correct theoretical shear modulus (~80.77 GPa) and compares it to the incorrect value from the original prompt, thus proving the inconsistency.
